apiTokens.title: API tokens
apiTokens.intro: Tokens let scripts and other programs call the API on your behalf. Send one as "Authorization: Bearer <token>".

collectors.title: Collectors
collectors.intro: Collectors are programs in the collectors folder that fetch addresses from a source. A run makes the streets, house numbers and geo objects the collector owns match what it returns.
collectors.summary: {{created}} created, {{updated}} updated, {{deleted}} deleted, {{problems}} skipped or in conflict
collectors.cancelMessage: The collector is stopped and nothing it returned is applied.
collectors.secretKeep: Set. Leave empty to keep it.
collectors.logEmpty: The collector wrote nothing to its log.
collectors.empty: No collectors found. Put executables into the collectors folder and rescan it.
collectors.deleteMessage: Its settings and runs are deleted. The streets, house numbers and geo objects it owns become manual ones that can be edited here, unless you delete them too.
collectors.deleteData: Also delete the rows it owns (rows others depend on become manual instead)
